title: Bring Touch to your Mac app
description: Discover how to add touch capabilities to your Mac app. Explore how to transition from classic mouse tracking APIs to modern gesture recognizers and touch-native controls. Find out how to optimize hit targets, implement multi-touch interactions, and manage system gestures to deliver an incredible touch experience. To get the most out of this session, watch Design for Touch on Mac.

codeSnippets.title: Custom button that overrides mouseDown
Use NSControl events to detect tracking
codeSnippets.code:
// Use NSControl events to detect start and end of tracking
ignitionButton.addTarget(
    self,
    action: #selector(buttonDidStartTracking),
    for: [.trackingBegan, .trackingEntered]
)

ignitionButton.addTarget(
    self,
    action: #selector(buttonDidEndTracking),
    for: [.trackingExited, .trackingEndedInside]
)

ignitionButton.addTarget(
    self,
    action: #selector(buttonCancelledTracking),
    for: .trackingCancelled
)
